source.classification: Previously exposed, fully specified repository development fixture; not a textbook, unseen problem, or independent interpretation benchmark

purpose: A teaching accompaniment: faithful authoring, verified supported optics, meaningful inspection and exploration. Answer-key reproduction is optional and separately assessed.
author: Same ChatGPT assistant conducting and reviewing this developmental pilot
sourceInterpretationTask: Represent the specified source, ideal thin lens and passive detector in mm and x-right/y-up. Preserve every active physical value. First run without requested answers, then inspect qualified predictions and sampled measurements. Do not infer a material refractive index from an ideal lens. Do not invent a focal length when it is removed.

initialRequest.title: Teaching pilot: specified ideal lens and passive detector

sourceMapping.physicalValues: Each component ID, type, active emission field and numeric parameter is copied explicitly from the pinned source fixture. Inactive full-circle angles are filled only by the existing authoring implementation.
sourceMapping.numericalPolicy: dense-v1 must match the source fixture's rayDensity=1, maxRayDepth=8 and processedRayLimit=10000; this is checked before execution.
sourceMapping.presentation: The new title and engine-prepared camera are presentation choices, not new apparatus geometry.
sourceMapping.modelSelection: The existing minimal authoring interface selects its admitted native model family. Component geometry and interactions must match the source; the source model label is not imposed as a private authoring field.

experiments.classification: same physical baseline with passive readouts
explicit classroom physical intervention, NOT an original given
explicit numerical intervention, NOT a physical change
unchanged apparatus with an additional unsupported material request

expectedQualitativeChecks: The no-request scene runs without dummy observables or a textbook-answer target.
Adding passive readouts leaves the physical system and canonical native results unchanged.
Changing only focal length modifies lens ray geometry and conditional image position; a crossing count may legitimately stay unchanged.
Sampling changes emitted/crossing counts, not the optical model or the ideal-image relation. Finite-ray counts are not a continuous brightness theorem.
A missing optional material result does not become fabricated and does not erase valid simulation evidence.
The missing focal length stays missing, with no native scene, automatic repair or illustration default.
qualificationChecks: Separate scalar Gaussian-conjugate residual and per-native-ray thin-lens slope residuals; no expected answer is supplied to the simulator.
A test-only read-only incident logger observes actual lens and detector events, delegates exactly once and preserves native return values; it is not a new production observable or ray tracer.
Actual browser import, parameter edit, numerical-density edit, Fit, qualified export/reopen, and invalid-edit suppression; screenshots must be actual native renders.
Inspect screenshots and task output separately from numerical tests; teacher/student learning effectiveness remains not assessed without human participation.
stopConditions: No production physics, schema, engine pin or viewer changes.
No historical first-attempt rewrite, new answer-key lookup, external model, public deployment or automatic PR merge.
Record an unmet criterion or infrastructure failure instead of altering source facts to obtain success.
humanEducationalReview: Not performed. Supply a task worksheet and actual portable packages; do not convert automated checks or same-assistant visual inspection into a teacher-effectiveness score.
